## Changed

- Added separate On and Off buttons for DreamView and virtual group/scene controls in the Web UI.
- Added DreamView and ScenicView On/Off buttons in Home Assistant while retaining compatibility with existing automations.

## Fixed

- Fixed ScenicView commands and virtual controls returning a local 404 error.
- Corrected handling of unknown DreamView and ScenicView state.
- Fixed DreamView state updates from Platform push notifications.
- Kept virtual command controls available when their state cannot be read.
